production.note: US model years 2016-2024. Start: Chevrolet's September 2015 release gives the 2016 Camaro's "3.6L V-6" figures. End: GM Authority's 2024 page lists the 3.6L LGX V-6 on the LT trim for 2024 and states "The 2024 Camaro is the last production year for the internal combustion powered model." (source gmauthority-camaro-2024).

body.note: The 2017 brochure lists 3.6L V6 curb weights for coupe and convertible; GM Authority 2024: V6 in both coupe and convertible (source gmauthority-camaro-2024).

displacementL.note: Chevrolet states "3.6L". No opened page gives the cc figure.

aspiration.note: "Type: 3.6L V-6 DOHC VVT DI", "RPO Code: LGX" with no forced induction listed.

drivetrain.note: GM Authority: "Drive Wheels | rear-Wheel-Drive" (Alpha platform, all sixth-generation Camaros).

transmission.note: 2017 brochure: 3.6L V6 with 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic; GM Authority 2020: 6-speed manual or 8-speed automatic (source gmauthority-camaro-2020). GM Authority 2024: "6-Speed Manual" or "10-Speed Automatic" (source gmauthority-camaro-2024). The year the 10-speed replaced the 8-speed on the V6 was not confirmed.

powerHp.note: Quote, Chevrolet's release of September 14, 2015, table row "2016 Camaro", 3.6L V-6 column: "335 hp / 284 lb-ft, 3,435 lbs (auto), 10.3 lbs/hp". 2017 brochure: "335 hp @ 6800 rpm" (source chevrolet-camaro-brochure-2017). Unchanged to the end: GM Authority 2024 "335 / 250 @ 6800" (source gmauthority-camaro-2024-specs).

weightLb.note: Manufacturer curb weight, 2017 3.6L V6 coupe with the 6-speed manual. Quote (2017 brochure): "3,448 lbs. (manual Coupe)"; automatic coupe "3,435 lbs. (automatic Coupe, LT only)"; convertible "3,715 lbs." (manual) and "3,709 lbs." (automatic); the 1LE is "3,490 lbs." The 2018 brochure prints the same figures (source chevrolet-camaro-brochure-2018). Chevrolet's 2016 release gives only the automatic coupe, 3,435 lb, matching the brochure; the 2016 brochure could not be opened (HTTP 429), so 2017 is the reference year. See discrepancies for GM Authority's 2024 figure.

sources.publisher: Chevrolet (press release reproduced in full by GM-EFI, marked "Official Release")
sources.title: Chevrolet Announces Performance Figures for 2016 Camaro (September 14, 2015)

discrepancies.reason: Model year: 3,448 lb is Chevrolet's 2017 (and 2018) brochure figure for the V6 manual coupe; 3,411 lb is GM Authority's 2024 specification table, "LT Coupe | 3411 / 1547 | 3418 / 1550" (manual | auto), for the 2024 LT coupe, which by then had only the V6.
discrepancies.resolution: Used Chevrolet's 2017 figure for the stated reference year.
